common_risk: Waterlogging from heavy early rain can rot seeds.
recommended_action: Ensure proper field drainage before sowing if rain is forecast.

common_risk: High temperature during flowering reduces grain formation.
recommended_action: Maintain shallow standing water to regulate field temperature.

common_risk: Prolonged dry spells slow cane growth significantly.
recommended_action: Irrigate every 7-10 days if no rainfall; mulch to retain soil moisture.

common_risk: Excess rainfall during flowering causes boll rot and flower drop.
recommended_action: Improve field drainage and avoid nitrogen-heavy fertilizer before expected rain.

common_risk: High humidity after rain increases fungal disease risk.
recommended_action: Apply preventive fungicide and ensure good air circulation between plants.

common_risk: Poor germination in dry soil conditions.
recommended_action: Irrigate lightly before sowing if no rain is expected in the next 3 days.
Ensure furrows drain excess water within 24 hours of heavy rain.

common_risk: Rain during harvest damages yield quality and delays drying.
recommended_action: Plan harvest around dry weather windows; cover harvested produce if rain is forecast.

common_risk: Uneven soil moisture causes patchy germination.
recommended_action: Check soil moisture at sowing depth before planting.

common_risk: Heat stress during flowering commonly reduces yield across most crops.
recommended_action: Irrigate during early morning or evening on high-temperature days.
